mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (category_id, parent_id, [name], url, description, is_active, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{url}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{sortOrder}, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET is_active = 0, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.select:
SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.parent_id AS parentId, p.[name] AS parentName, c.[name] AS [name], c.url AS url, c.is_active AS isActive, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category_id = c.category_id) AS productCount FROM categories c LEFT JOIN categories p ON c.parent_id = p.category_id
AND c.[name] LIKE '%' + #{search} + '%'
AND c.is_active = #{isActive}
ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM categories WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
